header.name: Integral Transforms and their Applications
header.description: The course is designed as an introduction to the theory and applications of integral transforms to problems in linear differential equations, and to boundary and initial value problems in partial differential equations. The course assumes very limited knowledge of vector calculus, ordinary differential equations, complex variables contour integration, partial differential equations and continuum mechanics. Many new applications in applied mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology and Engineering are included. This course will serve as a reference for advanced study and research in this subject as well as for its applications in the fields of neuroscience, signal processing, informatics and communications. The course is open to all MTech, PhD students and some advanced undergraduates, honors students through instructor consent.
prerequisites_desirable: For PhD students course equivalent to MTH-204 (partial differential equation) and/or MTH-341 (complex variables)

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students learn the techniques of Integral transform and are able to solve integral equations.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students apply the transform techniques to solve difference equations, ODEs, PDEs

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to model physical systems involving non-linear DEs.

lecture_topics: Fourier transforms: Introduction, basic properties, applications to solutions of ODEs, PDEs
Laplace transforms: Convolution, differentiation, integration, inverse transform
impulse response function of linear systems
Hankel Transforms: Intro, properties and applications to PDEs
Hilbert Transforms: Intro, definition, basic properties
Stieltjes Transform: definition, properties, applications, inversion theorems
Legendre transforms: Intro, definition, properties, applications
dynamic linear system and impulse response
Radon transforms: Intro, properties, derivatives, convolution theorem, applications
Fractional Calculus and its applications: Intro
laplace transform of fractional integrals & derivatives
Integral transforms in fractional equations: fractional ODEs, integral equations, IVPs for fractional DEs, fractional PDEs
Some additional topics (external visitor): Orr sommerfeld equation, Proper Orthogonal Decomposition
